---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a control, connector, report, or workflow improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

Which ERP, accounting, stores, or workshop control gap should this solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the command, report, connector, or configuration change you expect.

## Data Sources

List the ERP exports involved, such as Odoo models, SAP transactions, or generic CSV files.

## Local-First Fit

Explain how this can work from local CSV/XLSX exports without cloud upload, SaaS storage, or live ERP credentials.

## Acceptance Criteria

How should maintainers and users know the feature works?

## Safety Boundaries

Do not include live ERP data. Do not request compliance certification, audit opinions, direct ERP connectors, or production-readiness claims.
